title: Ma Mama Musou: Maou no Mama ni Amaemakuttara Saikyou ni! Saijaku Skill [Amaenbou] de Musou Shite Akugyaku Yuusha ni Fukushuu Shimasu
description: A meeting with the Demon King’s mom changes the destiny of the weakest boy—an exhilarating, super-pampered & peerless revenge story begins! Solo, a dull boy who grew up without knowing his mother, joins his childhood friend’s hero party to defeat the Demon King! But after returning to the kingdom in triumph, the hero betrays Solo, casting him into the depths of despair!?
author: Ooi Masakazu
